More endpoints

GET /stations/{id}/json

Legacy station data. This endpoint is only served from the legacy host:

curl https://legacy.acmeweather.example/stations/42/json

GET /radar/{region}

Radar tiles, for example https://tiles.acmeweather.example/radar/eu. During the migration the same data is also available at https://api.acmeweather.example/v2/radar/eu.

GET /alerts/{id}

Returns one alert subscription, for example https://api.acmeweather.example/v2/alerts/7.

GET /history

Historical observations. During outages, see https://status.acmeweather.example/incidents.
